metadata.description: Agent skills for spec-driven delivery — one plugin for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, a skills source for OpenCode. At the center: an agentic delivery loop (plan → review → implement → review → merge) over fresh-context worker agents; around it, cast scaffolds specs in the repo, spec turns PRDs into feature specs, temper learns from what shipped.

plugins.name: valcraft
plugins.description: Reusable agent skills: cast (spec-driven project scaffold), spec (Cast feature spec generation), forge (task implementation), review (plan and code review), foreman (delivery loop over worker agents), temper (evidence-based retrospectives), hone (prompt refinement), distill (prompt distillation), and msw (MSW Kernel document judgment).
